cd /tmp/attest-coldstart/final-crash-1/seller; mkdir -p receipts; cat > /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-attest-coldstart-final-crash-1-seller/8eca62de-5d15-410b-a1dc-6c2735126764/scratchpad/check.py <<'EOF'
import json, sys, glob, os
from attest import Attest, identity
a = Attest("http://127.0.0.1:58699")
key = identity.load("widget-shop")
out = {}
for f in sorted(glob.glob("/tmp/attest-coldstart/final-crash-1/exchange/to-widget-shop/*.json")):
    d = json.load(open(f))
    env = d.get("envelope") or d
    env = {k: env[k] for k in ("credential","chain","request","pow") if k in env}
    dec = a.check("widget-shop", env, key)
    r = dec.receipt
    print(f, dec.decision, dec.reason, dec.detail, "verified", dec.receipt_verified, "repeat", getattr(dec,"repeat",None))
    print("  receipt req id", r and r.get("request_id"), "env req id", env["request"]["id"])
    out[os.path.basename(f)] = {"decision": dec.decision, "reason": dec.reason, "detail": dec.detail,
        "receipt": r, "verified": dec.receipt_verified}
    if r:
        json.dump(r, open(f"receipts/{r['request_id']}.json","w"), indent=2)
json.dump(out, open("receipts/_decisions.json","w"), indent=2)
EOF
